description: Use this when the user asks which cards are rising, hot, spiking, crashing or trending, in one game or across all games. Returns the biggest 30-day gainers (or drops) with the percentage change, measured on the PSA 10 price where the card has one and on the raw price otherwise; moves over 300% are excluded as bad data. Do not use for a single named card or for long-term history.

game.description: Restrict to one game or sport; omit for all.

limit.description: How many cards to return, biggest move first (1 to 50, default 15).

min_market_usd.description: Ignore cards whose raw price is below this.

name: trending_cards

basis.description: Which price series the change refers to

excluded_unstable.description: Candidates dropped because their own 40-day series did not hold together (too few captures, a baseline that swings >2×, a >6× range, or a one-capture jump).

title: Trending cards (30-day price movers)
